unmet_need.name: Unmet-need / complaint mining
unmet_need.evidence_pattern: people in a specific role or business describing a recurring problem, workaround or wish in forums, communities and reviews
queries: $subject "is there a tool" OR "wish there was" reddit
$subject "how do you handle" small business owners

incumbent_weakness.name: Incumbent-weakness mining
incumbent_weakness.evidence_pattern: users of an existing product complaining about price, missing features, complexity or poor fit for their segment
queries: $subject software too expensive for small teams reviews

regulatory_tech_change.name: Regulatory / technology-change mining
regulatory_tech_change.evidence_pattern: a specific recent regulation, rule, deadline, standard or technology change that creates a new obligation or makes a new solution possible for a specific group
queries: $subject API or platform change impact businesses
$subject law change what businesses need to do

manual_process.name: Expensive-manual-process mining
manual_process.evidence_pattern: job posts, service offerings or workflow descriptions showing people paid to do repetitive manual work that software or a small service could take over
queries: $subject job posting data entry coordinator manual
$subject hours per week spent on paperwork

market_inefficiency.name: Market-inefficiency / arbitrage mining
market_inefficiency.evidence_pattern: a gap between supply and demand, an underserved distribution channel, or a large price difference for the same thing between markets or segments
queries: $subject buyers can't find sellers marketplace gap
